name: Contemplative Cat

passive_description.localized: Increases Cosmos DMG by <lv>{1}</> for every <lv>{0}</> Fons the wearer holds, up to <lv>10</> stacks.
passive_description.source: 装备者每持有<lv>{0}</>方斯，光属性异能伤害提高<lv>{1}</>，最多叠加<lv>10</>层。

placeholder_mapping.{0}: buff_mamen_fons (DataList order 1, bIsPercent=false, count of Fons per stack)
placeholder_mapping.{1}: buff_mamen_CosmosUp (DataList order 2, bIsPercent=true, Cosmos DMG ratio per stack)

tested_hypotheses: Cosmos DMG binds to DamageElement::Cosmos packets; the bonus sums into the single additive damage-bonus zone (M_bonus), never multiplying.
stacks = min(10, floor(fons_held / 100000)) with exact integer division; the 10 cap comes from the frozen description text, which the projection asserts verbatim.
An absent fons_held input is rejected in combat validation and the damage path; explicit zero and sub-threshold values are legal and yield zero stacks below 100000.

Projection preserves caller manual input while rebinding native values; an absent projection input remains unresolved, while the public DSL requires an explicit nonnegative safe integer and carries it into the native proc.
Frozen package evidence does not establish Global release availability.
